text:
If you've still got evening plans on the water or the porch, tonight's about as easy as Burlington summer gets. Sun's already down, skies are clearing out nicely, and that north breeze around 8 mph will keep easing through the evening, dropping into the mid 50s overnight. Comfortable enough you might actually want a light layer by the time you're heading in.

Saturday looks like the pick of the week: sunny, high near 77, air quality good, lake winds light out of the north around 5 to 15 knots with waves just 1 to 2 feet, so it's a fine day for the broad waters. The only asterisk is the models don't fully agree on today's overnight, with the European model hinting at more shower chance than NWS shows, but I'd bet on the drier read given how clean the sky looks right now. Enjoy tonight and get outside early Saturday, since clouds start building again by evening as we look toward Sunday's rain.
